# Oravo

> Oravo is an AI dictation app built for non-native English speakers. Speak in your natural accent, or directly in your native language, and Oravo types polished, professional English into the app you are already using. Available for Windows, macOS and Android; iOS is coming soon.

Oravo works system-wide: press a hotkey in any text field (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Google Docs, Microsoft Word, VS Code, Jira, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Teams and more), speak, and finished text appears where the cursor is. It removes filler words, fixes grammar, adds punctuation and formatting, and adapts tone to the app (casual in chat, professional in email, structured in docs).

Key facts:

- Audience: non-native English speakers and multilingual professionals (remote developers, international founders, agency owners).
- Languages: speak in 60+ languages and get fluent English; translation also works in reverse.
- Code-switching: mixed-language sentences ("I need to email the cliente about the meeting") are understood and formatted correctly.
- Accent proof: Oravo is running a same-script accent benchmark across Hindi-accented English, Spanish-accented English, Hindi and Spanish speech to English, and a native-English control. Results will be published with method and sample sizes; until then Oravo makes no accuracy-percentage claim.
- Privacy: see the current privacy policy for how voice data is processed and retained.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://oravo.ai/pricing): Starter is free forever (30 minutes a month, no credit card). Professional is $9.99/month or $99.99/year for unlimited words, with a trial on install. Enterprise is $8.99 per user/month or $89.99/year (minimum 3 users).

## Free tools

Free browser tools, no account needed. The AI tools run on a lighter model with daily limits; the Oravo app uses stronger models with no limits.

- [All free tools](https://oravo.ai/tools)
- [Speech to Text](https://oravo.ai/tools/speech-to-text): record your voice, get the transcript
- [AI Meeting Summarizer](https://oravo.ai/tools/meeting-summarizer): summary, decisions and action items
- [AI Transcript Cleaner](https://oravo.ai/tools/transcript-cleaner): messy speech in, clean text out
- [Voice to Email](https://oravo.ai/tools/voice-to-email): talk it through, send a proper email
- [Audio to Text](https://oravo.ai/tools/audio-to-text): transcribe MP3, M4A, WAV and video
- [Subtitle Generator](https://oravo.ai/tools/subtitle-generator): timed SRT and VTT captions
- [Audio Silence Remover](https://oravo.ai/tools/silence-remover): cut the dead air, keep every word
- [Audio Noise Remover](https://oravo.ai/tools/audio-noise-remover): turn down hum, hiss and fans
- [Filler Word Counter](https://oravo.ai/tools/filler-word-counter): count every um, uh and like
- [Speaking Speed Test](https://oravo.ai/tools/speaking-speed-test): measure your words per minute
- [Microphone Test](https://oravo.ai/tools/microphone-test): check your mic in five seconds
- [Text to Speech](https://oravo.ai/tools/text-to-speech): hear your draft read aloud
- [Typing Speed Test](https://oravo.ai/tools/typing-speed-test): your WPM, then your speaking speed
- [Word Counter](https://oravo.ai/tools/word-counter): words, characters and reading time
- [Speech Time Calculator](https://oravo.ai/tools/speech-time-calculator): how long will your speech take?
- [Online Voice Recorder](https://oravo.ai/tools/voice-recorder): record, pause and save as WAV
- [Online Dictation](https://oravo.ai/tools/online-dictation): talk and watch it type
- [AI Grammar Checker](https://oravo.ai/tools/grammar-checker): fix the mistakes, keep your voice
- [Paraphrasing Tool](https://oravo.ai/tools/paraphrasing-tool): same meaning, better words
- [AI Text Summarizer](https://oravo.ai/tools/text-summarizer): the long version in, the point out
- [PDF to Text](https://oravo.ai/tools/pdf-to-text): extract text from any PDF, privately
- [PDF to Word](https://oravo.ai/tools/pdf-to-word): editable DOCX, no upload
